mentions.name: The Long Burn
mentions.description: A real-time space game inspired by the Expanse universe where players get a ship, take contracts and cargo, and plot flip-and-burn courses across the solar system, which includes all planets, moons, and roughly 800K asteroids that can all be visited. The game runs in actual time, so a trip from Earth to Mars takes days.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a game inspired by the Expanse universe https://thelongburn.space. You get a ship take some contracts and cargo, plot a flip and burn course and wait because the game runs in actual time so an Earth -> Mars run takes days. The setting is the solar system which have all the planets moons and around ~800K asteroids, you can go to every one of them.
mentions.author: gdotdesign
